title: Payment-History Window for LandlordGuard Renewals Paid in Full
content:
**Definition.** On a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal paid in full, the payment-history window is the span of calendar months, ending today, over which the policy's payment history is read. Its length depends on the returned payments posted on the policy in the 24 calendar months up to today: with two or more returned payments the window is the 36 calendar months up to today; with exactly one it is the 24 calendar months up to today; with none it is the 12 calendar months up to today.

| Returned payments posted on the policy in the 24 calendar months up to today | Payment-history window |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 36 calendar months up to today |
| exactly 1 | 24 calendar months up to today |
| none | 12 calendar months up to today |

## Reading the premium account

- A returned payment is an entry on this policy's premium account reversing a payment returned unpaid; it counts by the date it was posted.
- The count that sets the window always looks back 24 calendar months, whatever length the window turns out to be.

## Hypothetical accounts

| Returned payments on the account | Window |
|---|---|
| posted 3 and 20 months ago | 36 months |
| posted 3 months ago and 27 months ago | 24 months (only one falls in the 24 months) |
| posted 30 months ago | 12 months |
